data.name: Anwaarun
data.gender_notes: Anwaarun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Those who bring light and knowledge. The name Anwaarun carries the meaning “Lights” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Anwaarun usually hope their child will grow to embody lights and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who illuminate the path of truth and knowledge for others
data.etymology: Anwaarun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lights.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anwaarun total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: أنوارون
in_arabic.meaning: جمع أنوار، نور کی کثرت، روشنیوں کا مجموعہ
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أنوارون جمع أنوار ہے، جو نور کی کثرت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ نور کے معنی روشن کرنے، روشنی دینے کے ہیں۔ قرآن مجید میں نور کے ذکر کی جگہیں ہیں جیسے 'يُضِيءُ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ أَحَدٍ' (القرآن 64:8)۔ اسم أنوارون روحانی روشناسی اور معنوی روشنی کی علامت ہے۔

in_urdu.name: انوارون
in_urdu.meaning: جمع انوار، نور کی کثرت، روشنیوں کا مجموعہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: انوارون انوار کا جمع ہے جو عربی زبان کے 'نور' سے مشتق ہے جس کے معنی ہیں روشنی یا روشن کرنا۔ اردو میں اس کا استعمال روحانی اور معنوی روشنی کے اظہار کے لیے ہوتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقالید میں نور کی اہمیت ہے جیسے قرآن میں 'اللہ نور السماوات والأرض' (القرآن 24:35)۔

in_hindi.name: अनवारुन
in_hindi.meaning: नूर की अधिकता, प्रकाश का संग्रह
in_hindi.long_meaning: अनवारुन नाम अरबी भाषा के 'नूर' से बना है, जिसका अर्थ है प्रकाश या रोशनी। इस्लामी परंपरा में नूर का विशेष महत्व है, जैसे कुरआन में 'اللہ نور السماوات والأرض' (القرآن 24:35)। यह नाम आध्यात्मिक ज्ञान और आंतरिक प्रकाश की ओर संकेत करता है।

in_pashto.name: انوارون
in_pashto.meaning: د رڼا ډېر، د روښنۍ مجموعه
in_pashto.long_meaning: انوارون د انوار جمع دی، چی د رڼا یا روښنۍ معنی لری. په پښتو کلتور کی دغه نوم د معنوي او روحاني روښنۍ د نماد په توګه کارول کېږي. د اسلامي روایاتو په وينا د نور ذکر په قرآن کې دی لکه 'يضيء الله لكل احد' (القرآن 64:8).

in_english.name: Anwaarun
in_english.meaning: A collection of lights, abundance of illumination
in_english.long_meaning: The name Anwaarun is derived from the Arabic root 'nūr', which means light. In Islamic tradition, light symbolizes guidance, knowledge, and spiritual enlightenment. The Quran mentions light in various contexts, such as 'He is the Light of the heavens and the earth' (Quran 24:35). The name Anwaarun signifies a multitude of lights, representing divine guidance and inner illumination.

pronunciation.pashto: انوارون د ان-وا-رون په توګه تلفظ کیږي

data.cultural_impact: The name "Anwaarun" has a rich cultural significance in the Islamic world, as it reflects the tradition of education and knowledge dissemination that is deeply rooted in Islamic history. The term "Anwaarun" is derived from the Arabic word "Anwar," which means "light," signifying those individuals who bring guidance, enlightenment, and knowledge to society.
data.spiritual_significance: At its core, the name "Anwaarun" carries profound spiritual significance for Muslims, as it is a reminder of the importance of seeking and spreading knowledge as a means to draw closer to God. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "The pursuit of knowledge is obligatory for every Muslim." (Bukhari and Muslim)
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Lights" symbolizes Those who bring light and knowledge. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Anwaarun serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of lights.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Anwaarun was a title given to the caliph Al-Mutawakkil (847-861 AD) in Baghdad, meaning 'the light of the faithful'.

trends: Trending in Muslim baby name searches
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Anwaarun remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Layla Anwaarun in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Anwaarun, which means "Lights". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
